material_surfaces.surface: PFP default controller and demo composition
material_surfaces.impact: Both modules have eager catalog imports. PfpController default construction can fail through composition_root -> pilot_dispatch -> challenge_host_control -> challenge_execution, including callers requesting other demos.
material_surfaces.later_triage: Extract a versioned public challenge catalog/task/checker resource boundary in PFP and depend on it explicitly if retained. If retired, remove or explicitly refuse the challenge/demo routes and decouple their eager imports from the default composition root; deleting only tests does not restore default construction.

material_surfaces.impact: Selecting woland challenge lazily imports challenge_play, which eagerly imports the removed catalog and affected PFP challenge modules. context() also requires source tasks/case paths and catalog.py source pins.
material_surfaces.later_triage: Retain through an explicit versioned PFP public challenge interface or retire the Woland challenge route and dependent tests. An import rename alone does not repair repository-relative source resources and hash manifests.

material_surfaces.impact: Selecting woland mechanism imports this module and fails on the catalog import although its direct pilot dependency is only repository-root/canonical serialization/hash utilities.
material_surfaces.later_triage: Smallest extraction candidate: move the three generic utilities to an existing owned production utility/resource boundary and keep explicit source-root binding. Full historical pilot dependency is unnecessary for this import surface; alternatively retire the mechanism route.

material_surfaces.surface: PFP PO035 numbered prompt builder import API
material_surfaces.impact: Importing numbered_prompts fails eagerly. Its resource remapping also targets removed tasks.py and trial_prompts.py. A current production CLI route to this particular module was not established by this short assessment.
material_surfaces.later_triage: If retained, extract the explicit task/schema/source-context contract and resources into an owned PFP runtime package with versioned pins; otherwise retire the builder and its consuming tests/probes. Do not infer these task definitions are reusable outside their original domain.

material_surfaces.impact: Six eager checker imports prevent harness_tasks loading, thereby affecting harness_evaluator, harness_protocol, harness_replay, typed_harness_check and the separate entrypoints.research.harness_cli, even for exact_type/stale_input/workflow task kinds. This is not a finding that the separate woland research researcher_cli route uses this harness.
material_surfaces.later_triage: Review/extract the six mathematical checker functions and their dependency closures as an explicit optional runtime package if these tasks remain. Otherwise remove those task kinds and dependent resource pinning; isolate optional checkers so unavailable domains do not prevent unrelated task loading. No checker quality assessment was performed.

path_consumers.effect: Default load_seed_catalog raises PILOT_SEED_CORPUS_UNAVAILABLE. CLI pfp run-seed/check-seed loads this catalog first (entrypoints/cli/pfp.py:274-286); MSSN compilation bindings also pin this old path.
Runtime importlib loading fails when witness or outcome replay asks for mv/check_answer; this is a dynamic path dependency absent from the 53 direct-import list.
Legacy Education evidence paths remap into the now-absent Woland directory during frozen staging; replay source roots and pinned manifests need an explicit migration mapping.
Registration source hashing reads the removed design file and can fail; this is not just a documentation hyperlink.
Baseline CLI still selects the removed matrix path; treatment must be versioned explicitly.
Runtime source digest list still pins the removed catalog independently of the import break.
Resource alias map still resolves to the old owner paths.

path_consumers.target: C052/C054/C059 judge_packet plus C059 reference_solver directories under removed pilots
path_consumers.effect: Frozen harness source directory registration still names the removed directories; imports alone are insufficient for replay continuity.

package_metadata.impact: Setuptools still requests the removed pilot runtime subsets and data. A wheel build may silently omit them rather than fail; successful wheel construction would not restore the runtime imports or resource paths. No wheel was built.

other_metadata.impact: Removed evidence-directory exclusion is inert, not an independent runtime break.

triage_order: Keep removal PR explicitly draft/breaking until the owner chooses retained interfaces versus retired routes; record these concrete impacts rather than claim all consumers are tests.
First address default PFP composition broad eager-import failure and explicit challenge/mechanism/harness entrypoints.
Then resolve resource catalogs and source-pin/replay mapping using explicit versioned ownership; do not rewrite historical receipts to appear current.
Update package discovery/data declarations and installed-package probe alongside the chosen interface disposition.

Classify 46 direct test modules and installed-package probe by retained contract versus historical pilot coverage; migrate or retire them intentionally. Do not simply ignore failing tests as a substitute for an API decision.
limitations: No Anomalon Git read was needed; baseline/move statistics are attributed to parent.
No pilot contents, participant/judge fixtures, private answers or incoming pilot quality were examined.
Import and path failures are static predictions from absent source and source references, not executed failures.
53 files/138 lines describe the supplied direct-import inventory; additional path/transitive consumers listed here show this is not the complete blast radius.
No full semantic reading of the 53 consumer bodies is claimed; AST parses establish exact imports, and targeted production/metadata excerpts establish the reported uses.
